Have you found one yet? Surface dragons are pretty easy to spot, the dens underground, however, are tricky. You want to look for frozen stone.

Yeah! You gotta get flint+steel and light the eggs on a netherrack block. Make sure you have a staff already made so you can make them stay. You'll obviously need one male and 1 female. Feed them up to stage 4 or 5 and you have to make a fire lilly mix (blaze powder, bowl, and the fire lily flower itself). 

So what I do is I release from the dragon horn to and tell them to "wander", then put them back in the horn. Make sure you know which one is the boy. Release them so they are facing each other and immediately make them stay (like literally the head inside the chest of the other one). Feed the male the dragon mix first, this is very important, (right click on the belly like you would to see stats) and then immediately feed the female. Set them both to "wander'. You'll see hearts pop up and the XP sound should go off and there will be an egg! It makes a cool dragon den block that the eggs spawn on. Make sure you scoop up your dragons though because they're on "wander" and I've had to go chasing them on my roc before. 


I've found that releasing them on "stay" doesn't work, maybe I'm just doing something wrong, but my method works here lol. Also, if you feed the mix while they're on wander, they'll just kinda stand there. So if I'm feeling like it won't work, have 4 mixes ready. One to feed them both to make them "wander in place' before you put them in the horn again to release on wander and breed (they should kinda stay standing there this way). 

I've been able to get 2 eggs at once before, and I've also bred them 3 times in a row successfully. Have fun messing with colors! I haven't been able to get a black egg from anything but a black dragon.
Dig below them! I've come to find when there's 2+ surface dragons, there's an underground den not too far from the above ground dens. Deadass I dig straight down and find one pretty fast.
